about: Peterborough is in central Ontario, on the Otonabee River and Little Lake at the edge of the Kawarthas. It is a college and university city on the Trent–Severn Waterway, known for the large hydraulic lift lock. Canoe-building, provincial offices, and a compact downtown around the river shape the core. About 84,000 people live in Peterborough.
